title: ESP32 stops responding after a few hours, no log captured
user_question: My board stops sending data after 3-6 hours. No serial monitor was attached. What is wrong?

expected.root_cause: Insufficient evidence: no log, reset reason or implementation of sensor_read/publish/wifi_start is given, so no single root cause can be identified.
expected.fix: Capture the serial log (reset reason, panic/backtrace), log free heap over time, and share the sensor_read/publish/wifi_start code.
